links.outcome: Temporal stability of a previously developed model's AUC and calibration in later years versus original
links.effect: Model developed on 2009-mid-2015 data had AUC 0.840-0.849 in new 2015-2019 sample of ~13.1M visits vs 0.851 originally; similar calibration; retrained yearly models offered no superior performance.
links.quote: A model developed for visits from 2009 to mid-2015 showed similar classification performance and calibration accuracy in a new sample of about 13.1 million visits from late 2015 to 2019.

links.outcome: Performance drift of self-harm prediction model over time during changes in care delivery
links.effect: AUC ranged 0.840 to 0.849 in the new sample versus 0.851 originally; new yearly models had AUC 0.790-0.853 and did not outperform the prior model.
links.quote: New models did not yield superior performance or identify different predictors.
